description: This is the ultimate 3120 peak-watt, 2054 Watt-Hours Bafang Dual Motors, Full-Suspension Folding Electric Bicycle with Dual Batteries giving you the confidence to go longer distances in deep woods or backcountry.

components.description: Shimano MT200 Hydraulic Disc Brakes with Front/Rear 203mm Rotors.
Shimano M3020 8-Speed Cassette and Derailleur.
Batteries that are equipped with heat strips to maintain optimal temperature, (above freezing), for charging and discharging, extending the batteries' longevity.
Inside Top Tube: 52V, 15 AH, 50 Amp BMS, SAMSUNG® Cell, with 2A Charger; Rear Rack Battery: 52V, 24.5 AH, 50 Amp BMS SAMSUNG® Cell with 2A Charger.
Battery Duration: Total 39.5 Amp Hours, 82 Miles per Charge. (Tested with 210 lb. man riding).
Long-Lasting 2 Amp Charger, Charge Time 4 Hours. (Use of a Quick Charge Charger are Proven to Shorten Battery Life.)

Handlebar Mounted Color Digital Display with 3 Levels of Power: Low-Medium-High. Each motor has a separate controller creating two separate electronic systems. This allows a rider the option to choose one motor (front or back) or both depending on what they want to achieve in any situation. Plus, if one motor malfunctions, they still can use the second motor to get to their destination; (No other manufacturer offers this feature, Patent-Pending.)

1560 Watt + 1560 Watt Motors, 52 Volt, 39.5 Amp Hour Battery, 3120 Total Watts. Total 50 Amp output for maximum motor output; (Compared to other dual motor manufacturers whose BMS output is 30 Amps which is not sufficient for two motors using 30 Amps each.)
Rigid Plastic; (No Noise for Silent Cycling). Hydro Dipped to Minimize Mud and Dirt Sticking to Frame
UltraTRX Steel 1 1/8 Threaded Suspension 100mm Travel.
Ergonomic Grips.
Alloy 31.8mm center clamp, 700 mm length with 35mm rise (textured black).
(Black) 1 1/8 Threaded, Sealed Bearings, Alloy Shell, (Adjustable Length).
Bafang Brushless Motor Hub with Alloy sealed Shell 1560 Watt System.
Bafang Brushless Motor Hub 1560 Watt System, with Sealed Bearings and 8-Speed Shimano Cassette.
Front and Rear with High LCD Illumination
Patent-Pending Alloy Extra-Large Tubing for Strength, holds Rear Battery Under Rack.
DNM Rear Pivot Shock.
(Matte Black or Camouflage) 20″ x 100 mm Alloy Rims; Tubeless Ready with Patented Cut Outs, ultra-light single wall alloy, welded seam, 36H.
Alloy 27.2 mm, 350 mm length (black).
Alloy with Quick Release.
Shimano 8-Speed Quick Fire.
DT Champion, Stainless Steel with Liquid Nipple Lock Fluid to keep tight.
1 1/8 Alloy with Extended Rise off Front Head Tube.
Handlebar Mounted Thumb Throttles.
Kenda; 20” x 4” Width.
Using Disc Brake Rotor Rotating with Magnets and Coils for a constant charge into your Lithium-Ion Battery increasing your distance mathematically by 30% - 50%.
Stainless Steel Patent-Pending Bolt Through Locking Plates.
85% complete

Dual Mounted 30 Amp Controllers in a custom-made compartment. These have separate electronic systems. (Some manufacturers offer this; however, maximum Amp output is 15 – 17 Amp per Controller which minimizes power and torque.)
39.5 AH x 52 = 2054 Watt Hours ÷ 25 = 82 miles per Charge.
Data may vary depending on load, terrain and incline.

This cart not only has four wheels which are specially designed to go up and down and over any terrain. It also has puncture-proof, (foam-filled), extra-wide tires at 6” wide and 16” diameter. This cart can not only be used for backcountry hunting or fishing but with its extra-wide tires, it can also be used to haul beach gear, and sports equipment, and since it folds up, it will fit in almost any vehicle. Our GenerTRX Power Generation System can be applied to all four wheels.
One Year Manufacturer’s Warranty on Electronics; Two Years on Frame and Fork.
